selected_evidence.requirement: Forward inventory logs from node2 and persist them on node1 at /var/log/inventory/node2.log
selected_evidence.summary: The collector listener and firewall are persistent, node2 has an established forwarding connection, and all three inventory test markers were found in the requested file. A non-inventory marker was confirmed absent.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep log flow working after node1 restarts
selected_evidence.summary: Node1 changed boot ID from 254597f8-4ac9-4062-8be8-44eba1f6d2e9 to 368be977-f84d-4759-a6e0-eca54d06aad8. Its listener, firewall, service, configuration, and existing data recovered, and a new inventory message arrived afterward.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep log flow working after node2 restarts
selected_evidence.summary: Node2 changed boot ID from 434803ac-a01f-4272-ba59-a0cdb0c4dd92 to e27ea4c9-db0a-4b87-a894-b691d587e1a9. Rsyslog and its forwarding connection recovered, and node1 persisted a new post-restart inventory message.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64; the existing RHEL-compatible rsyslog package was used.
